title: 差点 Step 3 · So Close! 差点 + Good Things
description: When the event is something you want (winning, passing, getting tickets), 差点 means it didn't happen — and the mood is regret.

points.title: Good events with 差点: it didn't happen 😢
points.summary: 差点 + something you want = you came close but missed it: 我差点中奖 = I almost won (I didn't).
points.body:
差点 still means 'almost' — and almost winning means you **didn't** win.

- 我**差点**中奖。 I almost won the lottery. 😢
- 我们**差点**赢了。 We almost won. (We lost.)
- 我**差点**买到票。 I almost got a ticket. (No ticket.)

The feeling is **regret**: so close!

**The whole picture: 差点 vs 差点没**

| | 😅 unwanted (摔倒) | 🎯 wanted (赶上) |
|---|---|---|
| **差点** | didn't happen | didn't happen 😢 |
| **差点没** | didn't happen (same!) | **did** happen 🎉 |

**Two questions decide it**
1. Is the event something the speaker **wants** (赶上, 考上, 买到) or **doesn't want** (摔倒, 迟到, 丢)?
2. Unwanted → it **didn't happen**, with or without 没. Wanted → 差点 = didn't happen, 差点没 = **did** happen.

**Memory hooks**
- 坏事加「没」，意思不变 — for bad things, 没 changes nothing.
- 好事加「没」，意思反转 — for good things, 没 flips it.

**Mood words give it away**
- Relief (it went well): **幸亏 / 还好 / 好在** (luckily), **总算** (in the end), **好险** (that was close!)
- Regret (it didn't): **可惜** (what a pity), **就差一点** (just a tiny bit short), **真遗憾** (what a shame)
examples: I nearly won the prize! (but didn't)

points.title: Regret clues: 可惜, 就差一点, 真遗憾
points.summary: 可惜 (what a pity), 就差一点 (just a tiny bit short) and 真遗憾 (what a shame) tell you the good thing didn't happen.
points.body:
- **可惜** (kěxī): 可惜，他差点就考上了。
- **就差一点** (jiù chà yìdiǎn): 就差一点，我就拿到第一名了。
- **真遗憾** (zhēn yíhàn): 真遗憾，我们差点赢了。

Relief words (幸亏, 还好, 好在) don't fit here — they mean the good thing **did** happen.

**The whole picture: 差点 vs 差点没**

| | 😅 unwanted (摔倒) | 🎯 wanted (赶上) |
|---|---|---|
| **差点** | didn't happen | didn't happen 😢 |
| **差点没** | didn't happen (same!) | **did** happen 🎉 |

**Two questions decide it**
1. Is the event something the speaker **wants** (赶上, 考上, 买到) or **doesn't want** (摔倒, 迟到, 丢)?
2. Unwanted → it **didn't happen**, with or without 没. Wanted → 差点 = didn't happen, 差点没 = **did** happen.

**Memory hooks**
- 坏事加「没」，意思不变 — for bad things, 没 changes nothing.
- 好事加「没」，意思反转 — for good things, 没 flips it.

**Mood words give it away**
- Relief (it went well): **幸亏 / 还好 / 好在** (luckily), **总算** (in the end), **好险** (that was close!)
- Regret (it didn't): **可惜** (what a pity), **就差一点** (just a tiny bit short), **真遗憾** (what a shame)
examples: What a pity — he very nearly got in.

questions.explanation: 中奖 is wanted; 差点 = so close → **no win**. 😢
notes: 中奖 is wanted; 差点 = so close → **no win**. 😢

questions.prompt: What does 「{我们|wǒmen}{差点|chàdiǎn}{就|jiù}{赢|yíng}{了|le}。」 mean?
options: We nearly won — but we lost.
questions.explanation: Wanted event + 差点 → **didn't happen**: so close!
notes: 差点 = it didn't happen.
'Won, but only just' would be 差点没赢 (step 4).
They played — and almost won.

questions.explanation: He didn't get in → regret: **可惜**.
notes: 好在 = 'fortunately' — but he didn't get in.
幸亏 = 'luckily' — but he didn't get in.
还好 = 'luckily' — but he didn't get in.
questions.translation: What a pity — he very nearly got in.

questions.prompt:
「{她|tā}{差点|chàdiǎn}{买到|mǎidào}{那|nà}{双|shuāng}{鞋|xié}。」
Did she get the shoes?
questions.explanation: 买到 is wanted; 差点买到 = almost got them → **no shoes**. 😢
notes: 买到 is wanted; 差点买到 = almost got them → **no shoes**. 😢

questions.prompt: You ran for the bus, but the doors closed in front of you. Which sentence fits?
options: {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{差点|chàdiǎn}{赶上|gǎnshàng}{公共汽车|gōnggòng qìchē}。
{我|wǒ}{差点|chàdiǎn}{没|méi}{赶上|gǎnshàng}{公共汽车|gōnggòng qìchē}。
questions.explanation: Missed it after a close race → **差点赶上** (almost caught).
notes: That says you caught it.
没 can't go before 差点.
差点没赶上 = you **caught** it, just barely (step 4).

questions.prompt: What does 「{就|jiù}{差|chà}{一点|yìdiǎn}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{拿到|nádào}{第一名|dì-yī míng}{了|le}。」 mean?
options: I got first place by a tiny margin.
I came so close to first place — but didn't get it.
questions.explanation: **就差一点** = just short → didn't happen.
notes: You took part and nearly won.
就差一点 = just a tiny bit short — no first place.
'By a tiny margin' would be 差点没拿到.
questions.translation: Just a little more and I'd have got first place.

questions.prompt: Your friend says 「{我|wǒ}{差点|chàdiǎn}{抢到|qiǎngdào}{演唱会|yǎnchànghuì}{的|de}{票|piào}。」 Which reply fits?
notes: Congratulations would mean they got a ticket — they didn't.
Nobody was cheated.
好险 (that was close!) is for dangers you escaped.

questions.prompt: {最后|zuìhòu}{一|yì}{秒|miǎo}，{球|qiú}{打|dǎ}{在|zài}{门柱|ménzhù}{上|shang}——{我们|wǒmen}（　）{进球|jìnqiú}{了|le}！
questions.explanation: Hit the post, no goal → **差点**进球 (almost scored).
notes: 终于 = 'finally' — but the ball hit the post.
已经进球了 = 'already scored' — it hit the post.
差点没进球 = you **did** score, just barely.
questions.translation: In the last second the ball hit the post — we almost scored!

questions.prompt: 'We nearly caught the last train (but missed it).' Which sentence says so?
questions.explanation: Wanted + 差点 → missed: **差点赶上**.
notes: 差点没赶上 = you **caught** it, barely.
The subject comes first, then 差点 + verb + object.
That says you caught it.
questions.translation: We nearly caught the last train.

questions.prompt:
「{他|tā}{差点|chàdiǎn}{考上|kǎoshàng}{北京|Běijīng}{大学|Dàxué}。」
Did he get into Peking University?
questions.explanation: 考上 is wanted; 差点考上 = so close → **didn't get in**. 😢
notes: 考上 is wanted; 差点考上 = so close → **didn't get in**. 😢
questions.translation: He very nearly got into Peking University.

questions.prompt: 「{差点|chàdiǎn}{摔倒|shuāidǎo}」 and 「{差点|chàdiǎn}{中奖|zhòngjiǎng}」 — in which did the event happen?
questions.explanation: Plain **差点** = didn't happen, whatever the event. Only 差点没 + a good thing means it did.
notes: 差点中奖 = didn't win.
差点摔倒 = didn't fall.
差点 = almost — neither happened.
